messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up — OrbitData renewal is at risk if we don't sort procurement by EOD. They want invoices split across two BU codes (60/40), apply a $25k marketplace credit, and sign via DocuSign. Legal also asked for a data-residency addendum. Can we close this week?
Miles Chen: Do we have the current proposed ARR and discount on the table?
Priya Patel: Current renewal ARR = $240k list, we quoted 10% off for renew. Customer asks to switch to monthly billing and keep the marketplace credit; procurement insists on PO before we send invoices.
Ana Gomez: Monthly billing is OK from billing system side but we need the PO and vendor code up front. Also need GL codes for the split lines. Net30 preferred.
Priya Patel: Example PO they've sent (redacted):
```
PO#: <TBD>
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bill to: OrbitData - Finance (BU-A)
Line 1: Core inference seats - $144,000 (60%)
Line 2: Support & training - $96,000 (40%)
Marketplace credit: -$25,000 applied to Line 1
Payment terms: monthly installments, Net30
```
Jordan Lee: Adoption is at ~65% active seats, enablement kickoff next week. If we keep the onboarding momentum the execs are likely to sign. I can prepare a short adoption summary for their CFO to speed PO.
Miles Chen: For the discount: I can approve 5% for a 12-month commit. If they want 9 months we need CFO sign-off. Is the customer open to 12mo with monthly invoicing?
LegalBot: We need a SOC2 addendum and a data residency clause if OrbitData's procurement flagged it. Also confirm whether they require DPA signature and any additional encryption attestations.
Ana Gomez: Accounting note — we can split invoices across BU codes but each invoice must reference the PO and vendor code. We'll need to ingest two invoices into their AR system. Confirm GL codes and exact split amounts before sending.
Priya Patel: Proposed path: accept marketplace credit, allow split invoices (two invoices referencing same PO but different BU GLs), require PO upfront. @Miles Chen confirm discount. @LegalBot prepare SOC2 addendum template and DPA checklist. I'll schedule a 30-min call with OrbitData procurement tomorrow to finalize.
Miles Chen: Confirmed: I'll lock in 5% discount for 12mo commit with monthly invoices. If they push 9mo, I'll escalate to our CFO — likely slower. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: I'll create a one-pager adoption + invoice matrix (shows 60/40 split, monthly schedule) and share in #customer-success before the call. Meeting set: tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Priya Patel: Thanks all — action items: Miles approve discount (done), Legal to prep addendum, Ana to verify billing workflow for two invoices, Jordan to prep one-pager, I'll run the procurement call. Will post notes after call. :pray:
